content.text: I will now write the SQL query to perform the required calculations. I will use Common Table Expressions (CTEs) to first calculate the track durations in minutes, then determine the boundaries for the 'short', 'medium', and 'long' categories based on the minimum, maximum, and average track lengths. Finally, I will categorize each track, join with the sales data to compute the total revenue for each category, and output the minimum and maximum track lengths for each category in minutes.

args.sql:
WITH TrackDurations AS (
    SELECT
        TrackId,
        Name,
        Milliseconds,
        CAST(Milliseconds AS REAL) / 60000 AS Minutes
    FROM music.main.Track
),
DurationBoundaries AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(Minutes) AS min_duration,
        MAX(Minutes) AS max_duration,
        AVG(Minutes) AS avg_duration,
        (MIN(Minutes) + AVG(Minutes)) / 2 AS mid_min_avg,
        (AVG(Minutes) + MAX(Minutes)) / 2 AS mid_avg_max
    FROM TrackDurations
),
TrackCategories AS (
    SELECT
        t.TrackId,
        t.Minutes,
        CASE
            WHEN t.Minutes >= db.min_duration AND t.Minutes < db.mid_min_avg THEN 'Short'
            WHEN t.Minutes >= db.mid_min_avg AND t.Minutes < db.mid_avg_max THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Long'
        END AS DurationCategory
    FROM TrackDurations t, DurationBoundaries db
)
SELECT
    tc.DurationCategory,
    MIN(tc.Minutes) AS MinDurationMinutes,
    MAX(tc.Minutes) AS MaxDurationMinutes,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue
FROM TrackCategories tc
JOIN music.main.InvoiceLine il ON tc.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY tc.DurationCategory
ORDER BY tc.DurationCategory;

WITH DurationBoundaries AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(CAST(Milliseconds AS REAL) / 60000) AS min_duration,
        MAX(CAST(Milliseconds AS REAL) / 60000) AS max_duration,
        AVG(CAST(Milliseconds AS REAL) / 60000) AS avg_duration
    FROM music.main.Track
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN (CAST(t.Milliseconds AS REAL) / 60000) >= (SELECT min_duration FROM DurationBoundaries) AND (CAST(t.Milliseconds AS REAL) / 60000) < ((SELECT min_duration FROM DurationBoundaries) + (SELECT avg_duration FROM DurationBoundaries)) / 2 THEN 'Short'
        WHEN (CAST(t.Milliseconds AS REAL) / 60000) >= ((SELECT min_duration FROM DurationBoundaries) + (SELECT avg_duration FROM DurationBoundaries)) / 2 AND (CAST(t.Milliseconds AS REAL) / 60000) < ((SELECT avg_duration FROM DurationBoundaries) + (SELECT max_duration FROM DurationBoundaries)) / 2 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Long'
    END AS DurationCategory,
    MIN(CAST(t.Milliseconds AS REAL) / 60000) AS MinDurationMinutes,
    MAX(CAST(t.Milliseconds AS REAL) / 60000) AS MaxDurationMinutes,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue
FROM music.main.Track t
JOIN music.main.InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY DurationCategory
ORDER BY DurationCategory;
